biology: The host is the camphor tree.
soldier: Body small. Head earth-yellow, the frontal region slightly paler, the labrum and postmentum brownish yellow, the mandibles deep reddish brown and slightly paler at the base, the antennae and pronotum pale yellow. Head with sparse setae; long bristles arranged along both sides of the labrum; the anterior half of the postmentum with several setae; short setae scattered over the lateral margins and disc of the pronotum, the pilosity of the abdomen denser. Head elongate-oval, narrowed in front of the antennal sockets, the lateral margins almost parallel, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin a broad arc. Labrum slenderly lingulate, longer than wide, reaching the midpoint of the mandibles, its apex bluntly rounded. Mandibles sickle-shaped, the left marginal tooth at one-third from the apex, the mandibular body rather slender; the right mandible with a minute tooth at the corresponding position. Postmentum moderately arched, about 1.7 times as long as wide. Antennae with 15 segments; of segments 3 to 5, segment 3 is the shortest and smallest, segment 5 larger than segment 3 but smaller than the remaining segments, the terminal segment spindle-shaped. The anterior part of the pronotum is narrower than the posterior part and slightly upturned, the anterior margin with a distinct median notch, the posterior margin slightly straight and its median notch indistinct.
